task: Test whether a new runtime can satisfy Clarence-9 v2 requirements without changing stable identity.
claim: Runtime replacement is compatible only when the stable identity digest is unchanged and required policies and capabilities are verified.

confidence.basis: CPAS v2 protocol design and repository history; behavioral equivalence still requires empirical evaluation.

assumptions: The receiver can access the reviewed IDP and capability test profile.
Identity-digest equality is necessary but not sufficient for behavioral compatibility.

evidence.summary: Architecture audit found that the legacy declaration changed model family in place.

uncertainties: The target runtime and task-specific behavior tests have not been supplied.
